usedFor: PayHere holds your subscriptions, and Freshsales Classic receives a deal through “Create Deal” when one is cancelled.

bestTemplate.name: “Subscription Cancelled” in PayHere, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled subscription opens a deal, so someone can try to win the customer back.

watchOut: “Create Deal” creates the contact if it is missing, so check for duplicates in Freshsales Classic.
